# ↪️ Pull Request

Hi team :wave:

Fixes: #7433

`jsxImportSource` will be determined with `reactLib` variable, but `reactLib` variable is always “react” string literal if `alias.react is setted`. I think `jsx-runtime` (and automatic transformation) is not related.

I fixed this

  }

comments.body: This test case seems wrong. In this test case, `React.createElement` should be transpiled into `h`.

In order to convert `preact/compat` into `preact` pragma, I made a function to do it, but I feel this approach is a little muddy. If you have another idea to implement this, I will be happy if you comment on it.
Are we sure this is right? It should map to `preact/compat` in this case, which should have `createElement` (and may be different than pure Preact for compatibility reasons).

Oh I see ! I’m sorry I misunderstood :bow:
As you say, `preact/compat` exports `createElement` and does not export `h` and `React` is aliased to `preact/compat`, so `React.createElement` should be transpiled into `React.createElement`, so this test case is not wrong.

Thank you for pointing out!
